verdict.rationale: Claude supports persistent memory/context (chat search and memory, Projects with knowledge bases, custom instructions implied via Skills and Projects) that carries into new conversations, but there is no explicit documented feature for setting global 'custom instructions' that shape every response the way ChatGPT's system prompt does. missing for 10: dedicated persistent custom-instructions/preferences UI applying to all chats, independent/hands-on verification that memory reliably shapes every response, and clarity on scope/limits of what's remembered.
